title: MiniMax Voice Clone
description: Clone a voice from a sample audio and generate speech from text prompts using the MiniMax model, which leverages advanced AI techniques to create high-quality text-to-speech.

pricing.text: Each voice clone request will cost $1.5, with preview inputs costing $0.3 per 1000 characters.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.tooltip: URL of the input audio file for voice cloning. Should be at least 10 seconds long. To retain the voice permanently, use it with a TTS (text-to-speech) endpoint at least once within 7 days. Otherwise, it will be automatically deleted.

inputs.name: noise_reduction
inputs.tooltip: Enable noise reduction for the cloned voice

inputs.name: need_volume_normalization
inputs.tooltip: Enable volume normalization for the cloned voice

inputs.name: accuracy
inputs.tooltip: Text validation accuracy threshold (0-1) -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: text
inputs.default: Hello, this is a preview of your cloned voice! I hope you like it!
inputs.tooltip: Text to generate a TTS preview with the cloned voice (optional) Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: model
inputs.tooltip: TTS model to use for preview. Options: speech-02-hd, speech-02-turbo, speech-01-hd, speech-01-turbo
